reviews.comment: TA grading is super tough, prof is good tho, made time outside of his OH to help, record lectures and super clear criteria. prac tests, explained things. Can't say enough good things about him, take him if you can, this should be the gold standard for profs. somebody give him a raise. This class is made simple and ez to understand too.

Harris is a great professor! Super helpful, clearly wants the best for students. Extremely accessible outside of class. He even holds extra office hours the night before exams. Office hours are great: he's very kind; doesn't annoyed by questions or make students feel dumb. He's really funny too, and he always asks us how we're doing.

I will say 470 has A LOT of algorithms that you'll have to memorize exactly how they work, but if you practice, the tests will be a breeze. I recommend flash cards to help with memorization of steps. The material is very interesting, and Dr. Harris makes it fun and easy to learn.

MATH 470 wasn't the most difficult math class ever, but it definitely was not easy. That being said, Dr. Harris always makes sure that his students understand the material. If you're taking his 470 class, he doesn't test proofs which is nice. Dr. Harris has a genuine passion for mathematics and is great professor overall.

This class was hard but Professor Harris was so helpful. I knew I could always count on him to guide me through homework in office hours. Aside from the class itself, Professor Harris showed that he cared for each students learning. He also had a good sense of humor that would lighten the mood, even on the toughest days.

This is the first time I took his class, I gotta say that he's one of the gems in math department. Really nice guy! Lectures and lecture notes are very clear, organized and easy to understand. Will definitely take his class again if I have a chance!

Fantastic professor. I had him for applied algebra and he carefully went through examples in class and the homework was based off those examples. He would give practice tests before each exam and was always there if I had any questions about anything. I cannot recommend him enough. If you have the opportunity, take him you will not regret it.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Harris is very nice, and is so willing to make himself accessible outside of class. MATH 404 is not the easiest, nor the hardest math class, but he did a great job teaching it. Pay attention to what he puts on the review sheets-- the test is usually a subset of those questions. Come to class, as if you don't understand something, it'll pile up

Prof Harris is a great guy and always starts Monday class by asking how our weekend was. It was a total joy to have him as my professor for calc 3 even with early classes. He was always very helpful and would stay after class to answer questions. Exams are exactly what you would expect and infrequent quizzes encourage studying. Big recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Super chill and you can tell he really cares about his students and their success. Very willing to help whenever needed. However, homework may be difficult because his lectures are concept heavy with few examples. If you do the work, the class isn't difficult, but if you learn better through examples I don't think this is your guy

Really excellent prof. Makes himself super accessible outside of class and will answer any of your questions thoughtfully. Tons of HW and weekly quizzes, but they prep you well for what you'll see on the tests. This is a hard class but Harris keeps it as simple as possible and gives you your best chance at an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Harris was an amazing prof. His lectures were easy to follow, he explained things well, he was accessible outside of class, and he made the material easy to learn. Tests were doable in the allotted time. He gives one practice test, but does not offer additional practice tests or material other than the homeworks.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Harris is super laid back and connects with students super easy. I had computer issues and he granted extensions and was understanding. Uses 3D models for concepts, which helps. Sometimes a little word heavy in lecture, so I had to cut through the fluff and figured out the formula that worked.
I loved him and his class, very organized and very helpful, he really cared that everyone did well and understood the material.

I think Professor Harris is a fair professor. His lectures are straightforward and fairly simple, however the simplicity of his lectures makes the homework seem very difficult. He does have time for office hours and will make one on one appointments if you reach out to him and he is always willing to help. The exams are relatively easy.

Took this class as a freshman having accepted credit for Calc 1&2 and was worried about having a hard time adjusting. Honestly, Professor Harris was the best choice I could have made for this situation. He reexplains topics from previous calculus classes and also answers students' questions very thoroughly! Take him.

Overall great prof. Organized. Homeworks are challenging but on par for course. Posts practice tests and makes it clear what's expected of you and what kind of material will be on tests. Has lots of extra office hours, very friendly. Loves to talk hockey / basketball big Raptors fan. Lectures are alright but you'll need to learn on your own some.

Dr. Harris made success attainable over some difficult material; I had a fantastic time in his class. He is a very lenient grader who gives a lot of partial credit for answers that were on the right track. Beware the Edfinity homework - it's extremely difficult, but this comes with the bonus that the tests are very straightforward in comparison.

Very solid choice! This was just his first time teaching a senior level course. The class itself is hard because of algebra proofs but as the professor he is awesome! It was a 5 week course and COVID made that course online instead of in person. He is very helpful and friendly and definitely would like to take it again whenever there is a chance!

Dr. Harris lectures were enjoyable. During COVID he made the transition to online class very smooth. The homework platform needs to be replaced. The homework platform graded extremely tough and took hours to complete one assignment. Overall, Dr. Harris was a solid choice for diff eq. Only major issue I had in the course was insufficient exam time.

The online homework is unbearable (hours to do), tests are 6 questions long with multiple parts and graphing with way too little time, and the lectures are mostly theoretic with very few examples. The grading is fair and he is willing to help during his office hours. You will learn 15-20% in class, but the rest you will have to teach yourself.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There is no way a multivariable math class could ever be fun, but Dr. Harris' lectures are the closest you could get to that. The Webassign homework is awful, but his quizzes and exams are straightforward. He is a fair grader and an overall nice person.

I cannot tell you how amazing of a professor Dr. Harris is. He structured the lectures effectively which helped understand the concepts at hand much easier. Not only that but he has a good sense of humor as well as very easy exams if you do/go over the homeworks. Best math professor.

Samuel Harris is the best math professor in my opinion. His exams are relatively easy as the problems are very similar to the online homework and examples he works out in class. He is good at communicating with the class about what we need(homework due dates and questions). As long as you do the homework and take notes, it should be an easy class.

Prof Harris goes in depth in lecture and it shows he cares to teach the material. He is very responsive and will answer all questions in and out of class. Do the web assign hw and study for the exams and you will be fine. The course material is obviously not the easiest but having a good prof makes it much more manageable. Also always positive!

Prof Harris' lectures can be a little boring but his tests and quizzes are super easy. If you do the weekly WebAssign HW, and review for his exams there's no way you can get anything below an A. He communicates with the class very well and often cracks jokes. His quizzes come straight from the HW & are sometimes open notes. Would take again.
